evidence_quotes: Randvoorwaardenkorting wegens overschrijding gebruiksnormen Meststoffenwet door melkveehouderij.
overschrijding van de gebruiksnorm dierlijke meststoffen en de fosfaatgebruiksnorm in 2015.
rationale: This CBb decision concerns a cross-compliance subsidy reduction (randvoorwaardenkorting) imposed on a dairy farm for exceeding animal manure and phosphate application standards under the Dutch Meststoffenwet in 2015, and limitation periods under EU Regulation 2988/95. Under the coding protocol, agricultural manure and phosphate quota/application disputes under the Meststoffenwet are explicitly classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
